purpose: Visual negative-control review of the illustrative AI-generated contact sheet shown in chat, NOT source-conditioned FASHN Edit results

photos.review: Orange shorts silhouette cleaner, but generated waistband button/belt loops and pocket stitching are not established from the draped source.
Black jacket silhouette looks neater; lace/collar/fastenings and hanging accessory details do not establish exact same jacket.
Generated denim is blue/light washed with newly clear front pockets, fly and seams; original trousers appear much lighter gray and details are not source-verified.
Colors and broad athletic style broadly align, but fine mesh, laces, toe proportions and sole geometry cannot be treated as identical.

conclusion: This concept sheet demonstrates shape presentation, NOT source-faithful garment reconstruction. Do not pass it as an end-to-end image-edit benchmark or use any of its illustrative garments as a saved closet tile.
